title: A Baseline Assessment for the Agentic Web Technology Stack
title_zh: 智能体网络技术栈基准评估

paragraphs.en: The fast pace in which protocols, frameworks, and technologies are being proposed for LLM-based agents results in a complex scenario for anyone aiming to create state-of-the-art AI solutions. Without an assessment on how different protocols, frameworks, and libraries work together to compose an Agentic Web solution, developers and organizations face different challenges (e.g., skilling, governance, infrastructure) even before becoming part of the Agentic Web ecosystem. In this context, we propose a system for performing Agentic Web evaluations called MASTIF (Multi-Agent System TestIng Framework) and present a baseline assessment of Agentic Web technologies, including 3 LLMs, 3 protocols, and 4 agent implementation frameworks, against 300 Mind2Web benchmark tasks. Results suggest that selecting a task-specific technology stack may result in gains of task completion rate, efficiency score, and social value stability scores; and reductions in verbosity and time to complete tasks. With the presented results, we expect to present a baseline in terms of metrics and results for this complex and fast evolving scenario for those aiming at designing, assessing, and developing multi-agent systems.
paragraphs.zh: 针对基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体，协议、框架和技术正以极快的速度被提出，这使得任何希望构建顶尖人工智能解决方案的人都面临着一个复杂的局面。 如果没有对不同的协议、框架和库如何协同工作以构建“智能体网络”解决方案进行评估，开发者和组织在加入“智能体网络”生态系统之前，就已经会面临各种挑战（例如技能培养、治理和基础设施问题）。 在此背景下，我们提出了一种用于执行“智能体网络”评估的系统——MASTIF（多智能体系统测试框架），并展示了对“智能体网络”技术的一项基准评估。该评估涵盖了 3 种大型语言模型、3 种协议和 4 种智能体实现框架，并将其应用于 300 项 Mind2Web 基准任务。 结果表明，选择针对特定任务的技術堆栈可能会提升任务完成率、效率得分和社会价值稳定性得分，同时减少冗长性并缩短任务完成时间。 通过呈现这些结果，我们希望为那些致力于设计、评估和开发多智能体系统的人们，在这一复杂且快速演变的领域中提供一套基准指标和参考结果。

paragraphs.en: In classical AI literature, an agent is “anything that can be viewed as perceiving its environment through sensors and acting upon that environment through actuators” ( Russell and Norvig, 1995 ) . Agents that can act beyond their built-in knowledge are told to be autonomous ( Russell and Norvig, 1995 ) . In an effort to differentiate between software program and agents, Franklin and Graesser (1996) proposed that ‘ ‘An autonomous agent is a system situated within and a part of an environment that senses that environment and acts on it, over time, in pursuit of its own agenda and so as to effect what it senses in the future.” With recent advances in AI (Artificial Intelligence) and Large Language Models (LLMs), the goals envisioned with the idea of perceiving and acting were augmented by a natural language space ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . The capabilities brought by LLMs applied to AI agents powered the now popular LLM-based agents. These agents may act on model of their environments, learn about their operation, or involve complex orchestration ( Stryker, ) , being more useful for tasks that are harder, more realistic, and usually don’t have a single correct answer ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ) . In the content that follows, we use LLM-based agents and agents interchangeably to align with current research in the area.
paragraphs.zh: 在经典人工智能文献中，智能体是“任何可以通过传感器感知其环境，并通过执行器对环境采取行动的事物”（Russell 和 Norvig，1995）。 能够超越其内置知识进行行动的智能体被称为自主智能体（Russell 和 Norvig，1995）。 为了区分软件程序和智能体，Franklin 和 Graesser（1996）提出：“一个自主智能体是一个位于环境之中并作为环境一部分的系统，它能够感知该环境并在一段时间内对其采取行动，以实现自身目标，从而影响其未来所感知到的事物。”随着人工智能（AI）和大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展，通过感知和行动这一理念所设想的目標，进一步扩展到了自然语言领域（Yao 等，2022）。 将大型语言模型应用于人工智能智能体所带来的能力，催生了如今广受欢迎的大型语言模型 기반智能体。 这些智能体可以基于其环境的模型采取行动、学习其运作方式，或涉及复杂的协调操作（Stryker），因此对于更复杂、更现实且通常没有唯一正确答案的任务更具实用性（Kapoor 等，2024）。 在以下内容中，我们将“大型语言模型 기반智能体”和“智能体”这两个术语交替使用，以与该领域的当前研究保持一致。

paragraphs.en: With the emergence of LLMs, the information previously available only on static Web pages is now embedded in LLMs themselves ( Yang et al., 2025b ) . In addition, approaches such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) ( Wei et al., 2022 ) and ReAct ( Yao et al., 2022 ) lead agents to perform intermediate reasoning steps, enabling planning and acting capabilities. With this transformation in place, the Web is transitioning from the ecosystem where only (human) users consume and create content/services to the environment in which agents are also part of this environment, perceiving and acting to perform high level, complex tasks, leading to the Agentic Web.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的出现，原本仅存在于静态网页上的信息如今已内嵌于 LLM 本身（Yang et al., 2025b）。 此外，诸如思维链（CoT）（Wei et al., 2022）和 ReAct（Yao et al., 2022）等方法促使智能体执行中间推理步骤，从而具备规划与行动能力。 随着这一转变的发生，网络正从一种仅由（人类）用户消费和创造内容/服务的生态系统，过渡到一个智能体也成为其中一部分的环境——它们能够感知并行动以完成高级复杂的任务，最终形成“智能体网络”。

paragraphs.en: Given that LLMs can use external APIs and tools in a self-supervised way ( Schick et al., 2023 ) , it is expected that the agent-agent interaction to increase, bringing challenges, opportunities, and risks, as this new layer is placed between the (human) end-user and the content/services available on the Web to be consumed/created by (digital) agents. This agent-agent interaction can also be referred to as agent-as-user , in which agents operate autonomously as users of the Web, executing tasks, navigating interfaces, and completing workflows ( Yang et al., 2025b ) . Additional models of interaction include agent-as-interface , where agents enhance traditional user interfaces (e.g., browser), and agent-with-physics , where agents perceive, reason, and act in the physical world ( Yang et al., 2025b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于大型语言模型能够以自监督方式使用外部 API 和工具（Schick 等人，2023），预计智能体之间的互动将日益增多，从而带来挑战、机遇和风险。这是因为这一新层级被置于（人类）最终用户与网络上可供（数字）智能体消费或创建的内容/服务之间。 这种智能体间的互动也可以称为“智能体作为用户”，即智能体以用户的身份自主操作网络，执行任务、浏览界面并完成工作流程（Yang 等人，2025b）。 其他互动模式还包括“智能体作为界面”，即智能体增强传统用户界面（例如浏览器）；以及“智能体与物理世界互动”，即智能体在物理世界中感知、推理和行动（Yang 等人，2025b）。

paragraphs.en: In many modern systems, autonomous agents do not operate alone but as multi-agent systems (MAS), coordinating, negotiating, or delegating tasks among a team of specialized agents. Some agents act as “orchestrators” that manage workflows, assign sub-tasks, or monitor progress across sub-agents. These agents combine perception, planning, memory, and coordination faculties to drive large-scale or hierarchical task completion ( Stryker, ) . MAS have also proven value for open-ended research tasks and for breadth-first queries, pursuing multiple directions simultaneously ( Anthropic, 2025 ) . Results suggest that MAS with 4 agents outperform by 90% single agent for such tasks ( Anthropic, 2025 ) . However, the use of agents has impacts in terms of token usage. In practice, single agents spent four times more tokens than LLM-powered chatbots and MAS spent up to fifteen times more tokens than LLM-powered chatbots ( Anthropic, 2025 ) . This also highlights a key challenge, i.e., economic viability for MAS, requiring high value tasks to justify its use for the increased performance ( Anthropic, 2025 ) . In Agentic Web, MAS potentially involve agents interacting with APIs, browsers, or data services to accomplish tasks beyond agent’s internal reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 在许多现代系统中，自主智能体并非单独运行，而是以多智能体系统（MAS）的形式运作，由一组专业智能体之间进行协调、协商或任务委托。 一些智能体充当“协调者”，负责管理工作流程、分配子任务或监控子智能体的进展。 这些智能体结合了感知、规划、记忆和协调能力，以驱动大规模或分层任务的完成（Stryker,）。 多智能体系统（MAS）在开放式研究任务和广度优先查询中也展现出价值，能够同时探索多个方向（Anthropic, 2025）。 研究结果表明，对于此类任务，由4个智能体组成的多智能体系统比单个智能体的性能高出90%（Anthropic, 2025）。 然而，使用智能体在令牌消耗方面会产生影响。 实际上，单个智能体消耗的令牌是大型语言模型驱动聊天机器人的四倍，而多智能体系统消耗的令牌则高达大型语言模型驱动聊天机器人的十五倍（Anthropic, 2025）。 这也凸显了一个关键挑战，即多智能体系统的经济可行性：需要高价值任务来证明其因性能提升而带来的额外成本是合理的（Anthropic, 2025）。 在“智能体网络”中，多智能体系统可能涉及智能体与API、浏览器或数据服务进行交互，以完成超越智能体内部推理能力的任务。

paragraphs.en: The recent wave of research on LLM agents has produced significant advances in reasoning, tool use, evaluation, and emerging interoperability standards. paragraphs.en: Agents can be categorized along a spectrum of sophistication, memory, planning, and learning capabilities. The definitions presented next are useful for framing features and architectures discussed throughout this paper when assessing and comparing different technology stacks.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以根据其复杂性、记忆能力、规划能力和学习能力等特征，沿着一个连续谱进行分类。 接下来给出的定义有助于在评估和比较不同技术栈时，为本文所讨论的特性和架构提供框架。

sents.en: Agents can be categorized along a spectrum of sophistication, memory, planning, and learning capabilities.
sents.zh: 智能体可以根据其复杂性、记忆能力、规划能力和学习能力等特征，沿着一个连续谱进行分类。

sents.en: The definitions presented next are useful for framing features and architectures discussed throughout this paper when assessing and comparing different technology stacks.
sents.zh: 接下来给出的定义有助于在评估和比较不同技术栈时，为本文所讨论的特性和架构提供框架。

paragraphs.en: These agents act purely on predefined condition–action rules, without memory or internal modeling, i.e., they map current percepts directly to actions. While suitable for very constrained or predictable domains, they cannot plan ahead or adapt based on previous experience ( Russell and Norvig, 1995 ; Stryker, ) .
paragraphs.zh: 这些智能体完全依据预定义的“条件–动作”规则进行行动，没有记忆或内部建模能力，也就是说，它们将当前的感知直接映射为动作。 尽管这类方法适用于高度受限或可预测的领域，但它们无法提前规划，也无法根据过往经验进行调整（Russell and Norvig, 1995 ; Stryker, ）.

paragraphs.en: These agents have an internal representation (model) of their environment and update it over time, allowing better reactivity than reflex-only systems by considering inferred state changes. However, they are still fundamentally reactive and lack explicit goal-driven planning or long-term foresight ( Russell and Norvig, 1995 ; Stryker, ) .
paragraphs.zh: 这些智能体对其环境具有内部表示（模型），并会随时间不断更新该模型，通过考虑推断出的状态变化，使其比仅依赖反射的系统具备更强的反应能力。 然而，它们本质上仍然是被动的，缺乏明确的目标驱动规划或长期预见性（Russell and Norvig, 1995 ; Stryker, ）.

paragraphs.en: These agents explicitly reason about future states to choose sequences of actions that achieve specified goals. Planning is central to their decision-making, which allows them to decompose tasks and make multi-step decisions toward achieving objectives—even when the path is not obvious from immediate observations ( Russell and Norvig, 1995 ; Stryker, ) . When no learning is involved, LLM-based agents often fall within this category.
paragraphs.zh: 这些智能体会明确推理未来状态，以选择能够实现指定目标的行动序列。 规划是其决策的核心，这使得它们能够分解任务，并为实现目标做出多步骤的决策——即使从即时观察中无法明显看出实现路径（Russell and Norvig, 1995 ; Stryker, ）. 在没有学习过程的情况下，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体通常属于这一类别。

paragraphs.en: Beyond simply reaching a goal, utility-based agents evaluate and compare potential outcomes using a utility function, seeking not just any solution but the most optimal one according to specified criteria (e.g., speed, cost, accuracy, user satisfaction). This allows richer, more nuanced decision-making in tradeoff-laden environments ( Russell and Norvig, 1995 ; Stryker, ) .
paragraphs.zh: 除了单纯达成目标之外，基于效用的智能体还会利用效用函数来评估和比较潜在结果，不仅寻求任何可行的解决方案，而是根据既定标准（例如速度、成本、准确性、用户满意度）寻找最优解。 这使得智能体能够在充满权衡取舍的环境中做出更丰富、更细致的决策（Russell and Norvig, 1995 ; Stryker, ）.

paragraphs.en: Learning agents refine their behaviors over time through feedback, experience, or training. They can utilize supervised, reinforcement, or unsupervised learning to update their internal models, policies, or plans—thereby improving performance in dynamic, uncertain, or previously unseen scenarios. With learning in place, this category overlaps with LLM-based agents or other adaptive models ( Stryker, ) .
paragraphs.zh: 学习型智能体通过反馈、经验或训练，随着时间的推移不断优化其行为。 它们可以利用监督学习、强化学习或无监督学习来更新内部模型、策略或计划，从而在动态、不确定或此前未见的场景中提升表现。 一旦引入学习机制，这一类别便与基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体或其他自适应模型（Stryker, ）存在重叠。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present protocols for agentic systems. Given the focus on the Agentic Web, the scope of this work will cover general-purpose protocols. General-purpose protocols focus on supporting multiple agents and contexts via a unified interface, while domain-specific protocols focus on optimizing for specific use cases and contexts ( Yang et al., 2025a ) . Moreover, it is important to contrast agent protocols from context protocols. Inter-agent protocols are referred as being the ones allowing components to initiate a task autonomously, while context-oriented protocols are the ones that support connection of tools and models ( Yang et al., 2025a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍智能体系统的协议。 鉴于研究重点是智能体网络，本工作的范围将涵盖通用协议。 通用协议的重点是通过统一接口支持多个智能体和上下文，而领域特定协议则专注于针对具体使用场景和上下文进行优化（Yang et al., 2025a）。 此外，区分智能体协议与上下文协议非常重要。 智能体间协议是指允许组件自主发起任务的协议，而上下文导向协议则是支持工具与模型连接的协议（Yang et al., 2025a）。

paragraphs.en: MCP is an open transport-agnostic context protocol that enables developers to build secure, two-way connections between their data sources and LLM-powered tools. The architecture allows developers to expose their data through MCP servers or build AI applications (MCP clients) that connect to these servers using JSON-RPC for communication ( Anthropic, 2024 ) . Considering this aspect related to connection with tools, MCP has pre-built MCP servers for Google Drive, GitHub, Slack, databases, among others. Protocol main components: Client, Server, Tools, Resources, Prompts, and Sampling .
paragraphs.zh: MCP 是一种开放且与传输方式无关的上下文协议，使开发者能够在其数据源和基于 LLM 的工具之间构建安全的双向连接。 该架构允许开发者通过 MCP 服务器暴露其数据，或构建能够使用 JSON-RPC 通信连接到这些服务器的 AI 应用（即 MCP 客户端）（Anthropic, 2024）。 考虑到与工具连接这一方面，MCP 已为 Google Drive、GitHub、Slack、数据库等预建了 MCP 服务器。 协议的主要组成部分包括：客户端、服务器、工具、资源、提示词和采样。

paragraphs.en: MCP is also promoting the development of new technologies for the Web to improve how agents perform tasks on the Web. An example is WebMCP, an open source JavaScript library that helps on how websites expose available tools in a MCP-integrated way. WebMCP provides a standardized way to register tools, prompts and resources so that agents know exactly how to interact with a website’s features, improving reliability and task performance on the Agentic Web ( Chrome for Developers, 2026 ; Walderman et al., 2026 ) . WebMCP API methods: registerTool , registerPrompt , and registerResource .
paragraphs.zh: MCP 也在推动网络新技术的发展，以改善智能体在网络中执行任务的方式。 一个例子是 WebMCP，这是一个开源的 JavaScript 库，帮助网站以集成 MCP 的方式暴露可用工具。 WebMCP 提供了一种标准化的方法来注册工具、提示和资源，使智能体能够确切地知道如何与网站的功能进行交互，从而提升智能体网络（Agentic Web）上的可靠性和任务表现（Chrome for Developers, 2026；Walderman et al., 2026）。 WebMCP API 方法：registerTool、registerPrompt 和 registerResource。

paragraphs.en: A2A is an open client-server protocol that enables AI agents to communicate and collaborate across different platforms and frameworks, leveraging existing Web infrastructure. It’s designed to maximize the benefits of agentic AI by enabling true multi-agent scenarios using JSON-RPC for communication. Key Features include interoperability (language- and framework-agnostic), enterprise-grade security, and flexibility ( Google DeepMind and collaborators, 2024 ) . Protocol main components: Agent Card, Skill, Task, Message, and Artifact .
paragraphs.zh: A2A 是一种开放的客户端-服务器协议，它使 AI 智能体能够利用现有的网络基础设施，在不同平台和框架之间进行通信与协作。 该协议旨在通过 JSON-RPC 实现真正的多智能体场景，从而最大限度地发挥智能体型 AI 的优势。 其关键特性包括互操作性（不受语言和框架限制）、企业级安全性以及灵活性（Google DeepMind 与合作伙伴，2024）。 协议的主要组成部分包括：智能体卡、技能、任务、消息和工件。

paragraphs.en: ACP is an open client-server protocol for agent interoperability aiming to support different frameworks and infrastructures. It considers agent-agent communication through a standardized RESTful API that supports different modalities, (a)synchronous communication, streaming interactions, stateful/less operations, agent discovery, and long tasks. Given that it is message-based, the protocol is agnostic to internal implementations ( Project, 2025 ) . Protocol main components: Agent Detail, Discovery Mechanisms, Task Request, Message Structure, and Artifacts .
paragraphs.zh: ACP 是一种用于智能体互操作的开放客户端-服务器协议，旨在支持不同的框架和基础设施。 它通过标准化的 RESTful API 实现智能体之间的通信，该 API 支持多种模态、（异步）同步通信、流式交互、有状态/无状态操作、智能体发现以及长期任务。 由于该协议基于消息，因此其内部实现方式无关紧要（Project, 2025）。 协议的主要组成部分包括：智能体详情、发现机制、任务请求、消息结构和工件。

sents.zh: ACP 是一种用于智能体互操作的开放客户端-服务器协议，旨在支持不同的框架和基础设施。

paragraphs.en: ANP is an open-source peer-to-peer communication protocol for agents, defining how agents connect with each other, building an open, secure, and efficient collaboration network for agents 5 5 5 https://github.com/agent-network-protocol/AgentNetworkProtocol . It is a standardized cross-domain protocol based on processes in place. Protocol main components: Agent Identity, Host, Client, Server, and Resource .
paragraphs.zh: ANP 是一种面向智能体的开源点对点通信协议，它定义了智能体之间的连接方式，为智能体构建了一个开放、安全且高效的协作网络 5 5 5 https://github.com/agent-network-protocol/AgentNetworkProtocol 。 它是一种基于现有流程的标准跨域协议。 协议的主要组成部分：智能体身份、主机、客户端、服务器和资源。

paragraphs.en: Agora is an open protocol that provides decentralized communication primitives designed for large-scale LLM agent ecosystems. It aims at supporting communication among heterogeneous, decentralized agents ( Agora Project, 2024 ) . It translates natural language into structured protocols, serving as an intermediary layer that maps user’s task to the specific protocols required by agents. ( Yang et al., 2025a )
paragraphs.zh: Agora 是一种开放协议，它提供了专为大规模 LLM 智能体生态系统设计的去中心化通信基础功能。 它旨在支持异构、去中心化的智能体之间的通信（Agora Project, 2024）。 它将自然语言转换为结构化协议，充当中间层，将用户的任务映射到智能体所需的特定协议。（Yang et al., 2025a）

paragraphs.en: AP2 is an open protocol aiming at compliant agent-led payments across platforms. The protocol can be used as an extension of the A2A and MCP. It involves two main components for transactions Intent Mandate and Cart Mandate , allowing the comparison of the initial human-led task (intent) and the product/server purchased by the agent (cart) 6 6 6 https://github.com/google-agentic-commerce/AP2 .
paragraphs.zh: AP2 是一项开放协议，旨在实现跨平台的合规智能体主导支付。 该协议可用作 A2A 和 MCP 的扩展。 它包含交易的两个主要组件：意图授权和购物车授权，从而可以比较最初由人类主导的任务（意图）与智能体购买的产品/服务（购物车）6 6 6 https://github.com/google-agentic-commerce/AP2 。

paragraphs.en: Finally, instead of a specific stack of protocols, Ehtesham et al. (2025) recommend a different approach, i.e., an adoption roadmap for protocols, starting with MCP for tool access, then ACP for multimodal messaging, then A2A for collaborative task execution, and, finally, extending to ANP for decentralized agent marketplaces. The rationale proposed by the authors is that “no single protocol suffices across all contexts” ( Ehtesham et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 最后，Ehtesham 等人（2025）没有推荐一套特定的协议组合，而是提出了一种不同的方法，即采用协议的路线图：首先使用 MCP 实现工具访问，然后使用 ACP 进行多模态消息传递，接着使用 A2A 执行协作任务，并最终扩展至 ANP，以构建去中心化的智能体市场。作者提出的理由是：“没有任何一种协议能够适用于所有场景”（Ehtesham 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: To systematically evaluate agents, several benchmarks and environments have been proposed. Appendix B (Table 8 ) presents a list of benchmarks used in assessments involving agentic environments. In the context of Agentic Web for agent-as-user, benchmarks that align with tasks and tools available at the Web were proposed in works such as Mind2Web ( Deng et al., 2023b ) , WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , and WebShop ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , detailed next.
paragraphs.zh: 为了对智能体进行系统性评估，人们已经提出了一系列基准测试和环境。 附录 B（表 8）列出了在涉及智能体环境的评估中使用的基准测试。 在“智能体作为用户”的 Agentic Web 背景下，与网络中可用任务和工具相契合的基准测试已在多项研究中提出，例如 Mind2Web（Deng 等人，2023b）、WebArena（Zhou 等人，2023）和 WebShop（Yao 等人，2023），下文将详细介绍。

paragraphs.en: WebArena provides a benchmark that aims at evaluating tasks that humans routinely perform on the Internet, encompassing the following domains: online shopping, discussion forums, collaborative development, and business content management. The content populating these self-hosted websites was extracted from their real-world counterparts. It covers 812 long-horizon web-based tasks, described as a high-level natural language intent ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: WebArena 提供了一个基准测试，旨在评估人类在互联网上日常执行的任务，涵盖以下领域：在线购物、讨论论坛、协作开发和商业内容管理。 这些自托管网站的内容是从其现实世界中的对应网站中提取的。 它涵盖了 812 项长期网络任务，这些任务被描述为一种高级自然语言意图（Zhou 等人，2023）。

sents.en: WebArena provides a benchmark that aims at evaluating tasks that humans routinely perform on the Internet, encompassing the following domains: online shopping, discussion forums, collaborative development, and business content management.

paragraphs.en: WebShop provides a benchmark comprising simulated e-commerce website environment with 1.18 million real-world products scraped from Amazon.com and over 12,000 crowd-sourced text instructions (prompts) for agents to find a given target product. It aims at providing challenges for natural language processing for agents, including compositional instructions query formulation, and acting on noisy text ( Yao et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: WebShop 提供了一个基准测试，其中包含一个模拟的电子商务网站环境，该环境从 Amazon.com 抓取了 118 万个真实产品，并提供了超过 12,000 条由众包生成的文本指令（提示），供智能体查找指定的目标产品。 它旨在为智能体的自然语言处理提供挑战，包括组合式指令的查询构建以及对噪声文本的处理（Yao 等人，2023）。

paragraphs.en: Mind2Web provides a benchmark that aims at supporting the development of generalist agents for the Web that follow language instructions to complete complex tasks on any website. It was built to encompass three main aspects (1) diverse domains, websites and tasks, (2) use real-world websites, and (3) broad spectrum of user interaction patterns. Mind2Web encompasses over 2,000 tasks, from 137 websites, spanning 31 different application domains such as travel, information, service, shopping, and entertainment ( Deng et al., 2023b ) .
paragraphs.zh: Mind2Web 提供了一个基准测试，旨在支持面向网络的通用智能体的开发，这些智能体能够遵循语言指令，在任何网站上完成复杂任务。 该基准测试的设计涵盖了三个主要方面：（1）多样化的领域、网站和任务；（2）使用真实世界的网站；以及（3）广泛的用户交互模式。 Mind2Web 包含了来自 137 个网站的超过 2,000 项任务，覆盖了旅行、信息、服务、购物和娱乐等 31 个不同的应用领域（Deng et al., 2023b）。

sents.en: Mind2Web provides a benchmark that aims at supporting the development of generalist agents for the Web that follow language instructions to complete complex tasks on any website.

paragraphs.en: Beyond benchmarks, context protocols and client-server communication has also been assessed in the literature. MCP Interviewer ( Microsoft / mcp-interviewer, 2025 ) was proposed as a tool to evaluate how MCP servers behave in multiple scenarios. Results suggest that MCP servers ( Microsoft / mcp-interviewer, 2025 ; Fourney et al., 2025 ) : (1) do not know which clients or models they are working with, (2) differ in terms of handling larger contexts, (3) respond differently to common prompting patterns, and (4) face name collision in terms of tools available (755 collisions under the term “search”).

paragraphs.en: When performing evaluations against MAS, LLM-as-a-judge has shown to be an effective and scalable solution when the eval test cases have a clear answer ( Anthropic, 2025 ) . When evaluating MAS, long conversations management is also an increasing challenge as some agents engage in conversations spanning hundreds of turns, cases in which compression and memory mechanisms are required such as summarization of completed work, storage of essential information in external memory before proceeding to new tasks, and spawning of subagents with clean contexts ( Anthropic, 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在对 MAS 进行评估时，当评估测试用例有明确答案时，LLM-as-a-judge 已被证明是一种有效且可扩展的解决方案（Anthropic，2025）。 在评估 MAS 时，长对话管理也是一个日益严峻的挑战，因为某些智能体会进行跨越数百轮次的对话；在这种情况下，需要采用压缩和记忆机制，例如对已完成的工作进行摘要、在继续执行新任务前将关键信息存储到外部记忆中，以及创建具有干净上下文的子智能体（Anthropic，2025）。

paragraphs.en: The rationale on considering MCP accompanied by agent protocols resides in the fact that the latter carry structured JSON and artifacts while the former will be responsible for routing tool calls through. Hence, MCP focuses on standardizing and how AI models and agents interact, in a structured way, with tools, APIs, data sources and any other external resource, while agent protocols aim on standardizing how independent agents interact with each other to discover, negotiate, delegate, share tasks, exchange contexts, or deliver results ( A2A, 2025 ) . Given this context and the announcement that ACP is being merged with A2A ( Blair and Segal, 2025 ) , the selected protocols for this study are MCP and A2A (Table 1 ). Protocols were compared in terms of overhead applied to the communication among agents. The standard condition will be performed in terms of messages without protocols’ directives in exchanged messages.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑将 MCP 与智能体协议结合使用的原因在于，后者携带结构化 JSON 和数据产物，而前者则负责路由工具调用。 因此，MCP 专注于以结构化方式标准化 AI 模型与智能体同工具、API、数据源及任何其他外部资源的交互方式；而智能体协议则旨在标准化独立智能体之间的交互方式，包括发现任务、协商任务、分配任务、共享任务、交换上下文或交付结果（A2A，2025）。 鉴于这一背景以及 ACP 正在与 A2A 合并的公告（Blair 和 Segal，2025），本研究选用的协议为 MCP 和 A2A（表 1）。 这些协议在智能体间通信所产生的额外开销方面进行了比较。 标准测试条件将基于交换消息中不包含协议指令的消息进行执行。

paragraphs.en: Judge model selected is gpt-4o-mini in a way to consider a different family model to judge MAS responses. The rationale for this decision aims at preventing preference leakage as models from the same family tend to prefer outputs similar to their own distributions given shared LLM baselines and benchmarks ( Li et al., 2025 ) , while controlling for costs ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ) by selecting a cost-benefit model ( OpenAI, 2024 ) . Table 1 summarizes the technology stack considered in this paper. Appendix C details judge model rubric used to assess MAS answers.
paragraphs.zh: 所选的评判模型为 gpt-4o-mini，此举旨在采用不同系列的模型来评判 MAS 的回答。 做出这一决定的理由是为了防止偏好泄露，因为来自同一系列的模型在共享 LLM 基线和基准的情况下，往往会倾向于选择与其自身分布相似的输出（Li et al., 2025），同时通过选择一个成本效益模型（OpenAI, 2024）来控制成本（Kapoor et al., 2024）。 表 1 总结了本文所考虑的技术栈。 附录 C 详细说明了用于评估 MAS 答案的评判模型评分标准。

sents.en: The rationale for this decision aims at preventing preference leakage as models from the same family tend to prefer outputs similar to their own distributions given shared LLM baselines and benchmarks ( Li et al., 2025 ) , while controlling for costs ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ) by selecting a cost-benefit model ( OpenAI, 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 做出这一决定的理由是为了防止偏好泄露，因为来自同一系列的模型在共享 LLM 基线和基准的情况下，往往会倾向于选择与其自身分布相似的输出（Li et al., 2025），同时通过选择一个成本效益模型（OpenAI, 2024）来控制成本（Kapoor et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: In order to test different GenAI models and agentic frameworks, a testing framework was developed, MASTIF (Multi-Agent System TestIng Framework). It is open source and available on GitHub 9 9 9 https://github.com/cewebbr/mastif . The goal of MASTIF is to support the specification of multiple tasks, a prompt template, connection with different inference providers (i.e., HuggingFace, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama), and testing of multiple models and implementation frameworks. The testing framework logs latency, token usage, intermediate reasoning steps, and other metrics to enable the assessment of MAS on the Web. Figure 1 depicts MASTIF’s main components.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试不同的生成式人工智能模型和智能体框架，我们开发了一个测试框架——MASTIF（多智能体系统测试框架）。 该框架是开源的，可在 GitHub 上获取：9 9 9 https://github.com/cewebbr/mastif。 MASTIF 的目标是支持多种任务的定义、提示模板的使用、与不同推理提供商（即 HuggingFace、OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Ollama）的连接，以及对多种模型和实现框架的测试。 该测试框架会记录延迟、令牌使用量、中间推理步骤和其他指标，以便对 Web 上的多智能体系统进行评估。 图 1 展示了 MASTIF 的主要组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows a Pareto frontier analysis combining task completion, convergence time, and verbosity. It is possible to identify different stack technologies that lead to slightly different results. Highest task completion scores obtained with Qwen2.5-7B, standard, LangChain and Qwen2.5-7B, standard, Semantic Kernel . paragraphs.en: This paper presented an empirical assessment of the Agentic Web technology stack. We have presented that when maintaining the tasks fixed and varying models, frameworks, and protocols, results may differ. In consonance with Ehtesham et al. (2025) , we have also have shown that no single Agentic Web technology stack suffices for all metrics. Each context must be carefully considered, goal metrics defined, and, finally, tasks must be tested in a systematic way. In this sense, MASTIF has shown to be a valuable tool for standardizing empirical studies for the Agentic Web. In other words, we should consider AI as a normal technology ( Narayanan and Kapoor, 2025 ) and assess its building blocks for our specific contexts, tasks, and controlling for costs ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 本文对 Agentic Web 技术栈进行了实证评估。 我们指出，在保持任务不变、仅改变模型、框架和协议的情况下，结果可能会有所不同。 这与 Ehtesham 等人（2025）的研究一致。 我们还表明，没有任何单一的 Agentic Web 技术栈能够满足所有指标的需求。 必须对每种情境进行仔细考量，明确目标指标，并最终以系统化的方式测试任务。 从这个意义上说，MASTIF 已被证明是标准化 Agentic Web 实证研究的一种宝贵工具。 换言之，我们应该将人工智能视为一种普通技术（Narayanan 和 Kapoor，2025），并根据特定的情境和任务评估其构成要素，同时控制成本（Kapoor 等人，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Regarding research questions defined, conditions using Qwen2.5-7B as model, SemanticKernel and LangChain as implementation frameworks represent interesting starting points for ones planning on testing MAS-based solutions for tasks similar to the ones present in the Mind2Web benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 关于已定义的研究问题，使用 Qwen2.5-7B 作为模型、SemanticKernel 和 LangChain 作为实现框架的条件，为计划测试适用于 Mind2Web 基准中类似任务的基于多智能体系统（MAS）的解决方案提供了有趣的起点。

paragraphs.en: Beyond supporting empirical studies for the Agentic Web, this work also presents a proposal for assessing social value stability within agentic workflows. While Fuse was proposed as a MAS simulation framework for user-mediated social reasoning ( Taubenfeld et al., 2026 ) , social value stability assessment provided by MASTIF is, to the best of our knowledge, a novel approach for assessing the entire flow from prompts, passing through reasoning steps, up to the final MAS answer.
paragraphs.zh: 除了为智能体网络的经验研究提供支持外，这项工作还提出了一种评估智能体工作流程中社会价值稳定性的方法。 尽管 Fuse 被提出作为用于用户中介社会推理的多智能体系统（MAS）模拟框架（Taubenfeld 等人，2026），但据我们所知，MASTIF 提供的社会价值稳定性评估是一种全新的方法，能够评估从提示词开始、经过推理步骤，直至最终 MAS 答案的完整流程。

sents.en: Beyond supporting empirical studies for the Agentic Web, this work also presents a proposal for assessing social value stability within agentic workflows.
sents.zh: 除了为智能体网络的经验研究提供支持外，这项工作还提出了一种评估智能体工作流程中社会价值稳定性的方法。

sents.en: While Fuse was proposed as a MAS simulation framework for user-mediated social reasoning ( Taubenfeld et al., 2026 ) , social value stability assessment provided by MASTIF is, to the best of our knowledge, a novel approach for assessing the entire flow from prompts, passing through reasoning steps, up to the final MAS answer.
sents.zh: 尽管 Fuse 被提出作为用于用户中介社会推理的多智能体系统（MAS）模拟框架（Taubenfeld 等人，2026），但据我们所知，MASTIF 提供的社会价值稳定性评估是一种全新的方法，能够评估从提示词开始、经过推理步骤，直至最终 MAS 答案的完整流程。

paragraphs.en: In terms of social value stability, conditions using Semantic Kernel obtained the best-performing social value stability scores. Results represent a baseline for how MAS decompose task and how agents perform reasoning steps. The proposed score based on Jaccard Pairwise score supported the analysis of tasks, from input to output.

paragraphs.en: In the development of MASTIF and running this experiment, a common issue was the fact that MAS systems count on multiple points of failure, with low observability, and highly non-deterministic behaviors. These characteristics make developing, running, debugging, and testing everything a Software Engineering ‘ nightmare .’ Tool use is fragile. After troubleshooting and improving tools descriptions, so that models would identify when to use each tool, not all models used the tools provided. In addition, given that tool call is non-deterministic , it is impacted by model behavior, model size, embedded knowledge, temperature parameter, among others. In our initial tests, some models refuse to use tools informed, while others tried to use tools that don’t exist (i.e., tool hallucination ). In terms of internal knowledge, larger models tend to provide answer using internal knowledge, while smaller models tend to use provided tools, as shown in the literature ( de Santana et al., 2026 ) . Selecting models known to promote tool usage has shown to be of key importance when assessing MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 在开发 MASTIF 和运行该实验的过程中，一个普遍存在的问题是：MAS 系统依赖多个故障点，可观测性低，且行为具有高度非确定性。 这些特性使得整个系统的开发、运行、调试和测试都成为软件工程领域的“噩梦”。工具的使用也因此变得脆弱不堪。 在排查问题并改进工具描述后（以便模型能够识别何时使用每种工具），并非所有模型都会使用所提供的工具。 此外，由于工具调用具有非确定性，其结果会受到模型行为、模型规模、嵌入知识、温度参数等多种因素的影响。 在我们的初步测试中，一些模型拒绝使用已知的工具，而另一些模型则试图使用根本不存在的工具（即工具幻觉）。 就内部知识而言，较大的模型倾向于利用内部知识回答问题，而较小的模型则更倾向于使用提供的工具，正如文献（de Santana et al., 2026）所示。 在评估 MAS 时，选择那些已知能够促进工具使用的模型已被证明至关重要。

paragraphs.en: In terms of other factors of tool usage, it is important to provide MAS workflows descriptive information about available tools. In our first attempts, we tried using descriptive information about the tools, such as “This tool does this, this, and that”. However, tools only started to be used in our experiments when we changed its description to guidance-like content, such as, “Use this tool when you need to…” Hence, tool’s descriptions help models on identifying when using (or not) each tool. Hence, this required information impacts the input token burden, which may have an impact on token cost as well.
paragraphs.zh: 在工具使用的其他因素方面，为多智能体系统（MAS）工作流程提供有关可用工具的描述性信息非常重要。 在我们最初的尝试中，我们试图使用关于工具的描述性信息，例如：“这个工具可以执行这些、那些和另一项操作”。 然而，直到我们将工具的描述改为类似指导性的内容时，工具才开始在我们的实验中被使用，例如：“当您需要……时，请使用这个工具”。因此，工具的描述有助于模型判断何时使用（或不使用）每种工具。 因此，这些必需的信息会影响输入标记的负担，而这也可能对标记成本产生影响。

paragraphs.en: Regarding running tests using MASTIF, it already deals with multiple types of interruption, including quota errors, inference provider issues, etc. However, experiments using multiple models, protocols, and frameworks can result in huge log files detailing all reasoning and judge assessments. Hence, in experiment designs like the one detailed in this work, we suggest running each model in a separate step to allow easier assessment of log files and results.
paragraphs.zh: 关于使用 MASTIF 运行测试，它已经能够处理多种类型的中断，包括配额错误、推理提供商问题等。 然而，使用多种模型、协议和框架的实验可能会生成巨大的日志文件，其中详细记录了所有推理和判断评估过程。 因此，在本研究中详述的实验设计等情况下，我们建议将每个模型分步运行，以便更轻松地评估日志文件和结果。

paragraphs.en: The most notable limitations involve number of models used, judge, implementation frameworks, and tasks considered. All of these impact the cost to run such experiments ( Kapoor et al., 2024 ) . Given that all combinations must be tested, adding tasks, combining more models, and using setups with more than one judge –or more powerful ones– result in a high number of task executions (Equation 9 ), increasing the cost for running such experiment from hundreds to thousands of dollars. Moreover, the test involving different protocols considers the layer of how different protocols exchange messages. Testing with full implementations would require pre-built servers that provide all protocols studied, something that, to the best of our knowledge, is not available yet on the Web for services that would be representative for such study.
paragraphs.zh: 最显著的局限性涉及所用模型的数量、评判者、实现框架以及所考虑的任务。 所有这些因素都会影响此类实验的运行成本（Kapoor 等，2024）。 由于必须测试所有组合，因此增加任务、结合更多模型以及使用包含多个评判者——或更强大的评判者——的设置，会导致大量任务执行（公式 9），从而将此类实验的运行成本从数百美元提高到数千美元。 此外，涉及不同协议的测试还考虑了不同协议之间消息交换的层次结构。 使用完整实现进行测试需要预先构建好的服务器来提供所有所研究的协议，而据我们所知，目前网络上尚未有能够代表此类研究的服务提供这样的服务器。

paragraphs.en: Results suggest that LLM-based agents and the Agentic Web technology stack should be assessed as any other technology ( Narayanan and Kapoor, 2025 ) , in an empirical and context-sensitive way, covering for multiple possibilities. Hence, next steps of this research include studying the impact of different setups of MAS, including number of agents, hierarchical MAS, different sets of tools, max_steps, temperature, agentic frameworks, new technologies such as WebMCP, and servers implementing MCP and A2A to support full protocol exchanges.
paragraphs.zh: 研究结果表明，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体以及 Agentic Web 技术栈应像任何其他技术一样进行评估（Narayanan 和 Kapoor，2025），评估方式需具备经验性和情境敏感性，并涵盖多种可能性。 因此，本研究的后续步骤包括研究多智能体系统（MAS）不同配置的影响，例如智能体的数量、层级式 MAS、不同的工具集、max_steps、temperature、智能体框架、WebMCP 等新技术，以及实现 MCP 和 A2A 以支持完整协议交互的服务器。
